# XWhy: eXplain Why

> XWhy is an open-source Python package for model-agnostic local explainability using SMILE.

XWhy explains the local behaviour of machine-learning and generative AI models. Image-classification and LLM explainers are currently available. Image-generation, tabular, text, point-cloud, time-series, and multimodal capabilities are documented with their current development status.

Package name: `xwhy`

Install with `pip install xwhy`.

## Official resources

- [XWhy documentation](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/): Official documentation and capability overview.
- [Install XWhy](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/getting-started/installation/): Installation and optional dependencies.
- [Quick start](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/getting-started/quick-start/): First explanation workflow.
- [Choose an explainer](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/getting-started/choosing-an-explainer/): Select the correct implemented workflow.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Dependable-Intelligent-Systems-Lab/xwhy): Source code, issues, and releases.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/xwhy/): Installable Python distribution.
- [Python API reference](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/reference/xwhy/): Generated package reference.

## Explainers

- [Explainer overview](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/): Supported and planned explainers.
- [Image classification](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image/): Image-classification explainability.
- [Image generation](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image-generation/): Image-generation explainability roadmap.
- [Image editing](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image-generation/image-editing/): Image-editing explainability status.
- [Pix2Pix models](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image-generation/pix2pix-models/): Pix2Pix as an image-editing model example.
- [LLM explainability](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/llm/): LLM prompt-response explainability.
- [Tabular](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/tabular/): Tabular explainer development status.
- [Text](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/text/): Text explainer development status.
- [Point cloud](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/point-cloud/): Point-cloud explainer development status.
- [Time series](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/time-series/): Time-series explainability roadmap.
- [Multimodal](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/multimodal/): Multimodal explainability roadmap.

## Concepts and responsible use

- [How SMILE works](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/concepts/smile/): The explanation workflow underlying XWhy.
- [Local explanations](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/concepts/local-explanations/): Scope and interpretation of local explanations.

## Evaluation

- [Evaluation overview](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/): Modality-aware explanation evaluation.
- [ATT fidelity](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-fidelity/): Fidelity and implemented surrogate metrics.
- [ATT accuracy](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-accuracy/): Attribution accuracy and image coverage functions.
- [ATT stability](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-stability/): Stability under small input changes.
- [ATT consistency](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-consistency/): Consistency across repeated executions.
- [ATT faithfulness](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-faithfulness/): Faithfulness under interventions.
